kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.ingatan.utusa: Went as the sect's envoy to %s.
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.utusan.t: The Elder of External Affairs or a free Golden Core+ disciple travels for one day. Back: standing +5 (+3 for the Elder; half for the demonic path) and their gate is known. 3-day wait.
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.hadiah_k: From the hall's CP pool: standing +5 (half for the demonic path). Once a day per sect.
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.hadiah_s: From the hall's CP pool: standing +10 (half for the demonic path). Once a day per sect.
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.hadiah_b: From the hall's CP pool: standing +15 (half for the demonic path). Once a day per sect.
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.pakta.ti: From standing 20: no raids, no poaching of disciples and no mission ambushes from them, and the standing never drifts below 20.
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.sekutu.t: From standing 60, never the demonic path: two allied guards come to a raid, their defence counts when a raid is settled as data, a weekly CP gift, joint tournaments.
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.tuntut.t: Hall level at least their tier + 2. A weak sect pays tier × 30 CP (standing −10); a proud one refuses (−15) and may declare war. 7-day wait.
An inter-sect tournament in your hall's arena (tournament module). A win +10, a loss −10. 5-day wait.
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.perang.t: Standing below −30, no pact. They raid every 3-5 days on the sect raid schedule; defeat their master at its mountain gate to win. Three sacked raids lose the war (forced tribute, never blocks or disciples).
kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.aksi.damai.ti: Accepted when they are weaker than your hall, you won two raids, or the war is 12 days old. Refused: wait 2 days.
No envoy: needs the Elder of External Affairs or a free Golden Core+ disciple in the world.
The demonic path makes no alliances.
Needs a standing of at least %s.
Not enough CP in the hall pool (needs %s).

Not to an ally or a vassal.
War is switched off in the config.

kultivator.sekte.diplomasi.tawaran.ketua: Accept: their master comes to your hall for the deciding duel (once a day). Defeat them to win the war.
